header.title: Property List
header.description: Compact key/value pairs with `<dl>` semantics. Use it to show details of an order, an account or a configuration. Build rows with `items` or with `PropertyList.Item`.

playground.title: Playground
playground.description: Adjust the props to see the list and the code. Below 40rem all columns stack into one.

base.title: Basic usage
base.description: Pass `title` and `items`. Each item has a `label` (the term) and `children` (the value). By default rows are divided and the label ends with a colon.

columns.title: Columns
columns.description: `columns` lays rows out in a grid of 1 to 6 columns. `span` makes an item take more than one column; it never exceeds `columns`.

bordered.title: Bordered
bordered.description: `bordered` adds a border, background and padding, and separates the header. With `divided`, cells get inner lines.

vertical.title: Vertical
vertical.description: `layout="vertical"` puts the label above the value. It looks better without a colon: `colon={false}`.

striped.title: Striped
striped.description: `striped` fills the background of even rows. Combine it with `divided={false}` so lines don't add up. It doesn't apply with `bordered`.

sizes.title: Sizes
sizes.description: `size` accepts `sm`, `md` (default) and `lg`. It changes the padding and the gaps between label, value and columns.

compound.title: Composition
compound.description: `PropertyList.Item` builds rows as children, handy when the value is JSX. `extra` adds content at the end of the header, like a `Badge`.

copy.title: Values with actions
copy.description: The value can hold any node: here a `CopyToClipboard` and a `Badge`. Give the copy button a `copyAriaLabel` that says what it copies.

align.title: Alignment and label width
align.description: `align="end"` right-aligns the values, great for amounts. `labelWidth` fixes the width of the label column; a number is read as pixels.

hidden.title: Hidden rows
hidden.description: `hidden: true` skips an item without removing it from the array. Use it to show fields based on permissions or preferences. Turn on the switch.

empty.title: Empty values
empty.description: When a value is `null`, `undefined`, a boolean or an empty string, `emptyText` is shown (an em dash by default). Screen readers may skip the dash: pass text like "Not set".

apiLink: See the full Property List API

header.title: Property List API
header.description: API reference for the React PropertyList: list and item props, helpers, CSS classes, variables, tokens and exported types.

demos.title: Demos
demos.description: For examples and usage details, visit the component demos page.

import.title: Import
import.description: Import it from the main entry or from its subpath. `PropertyListItemConfig` types the `items` array.

inheritance.title: Inheritance
inheritance.body: PropertyList accepts <section> attributes except title, which is the header here. They go to the root along with ref. style is merged with --gem-property-list-cols and --gem-property-list-label-width. PropertyList.Item accepts <div> attributes except children.

a11y.title: Accessibility
a11y.semantics: Rows use <dl>, <dt> and <dd>, so screen readers announce each pair as term and definition.
a11y.heading: A text title renders as an <h3>. If you pass a node, it's a div and isn't exposed as a heading; include the heading yourself if you need one.
a11y.region: The root is a <section> with aria-labelledby pointing to the title. Without a title, pass aria-label or aria-labelledby.
a11y.colon: The colon comes from CSS (::after); it isn't part of the label text.
a11y.empty: The default emptyText is an em dash (—), which many screen readers skip or read as "dash". Pass text like "Not set".
a11y.values: If the value has icon buttons, like CopyToClipboard, give them a name that includes the term: "Copy Client ID".
a11y.responsive: Below 40rem the grid switches to one column and span is ignored, so the reading order stays the same.

cssClasses.title: CSS classes
cssClasses.description: Classes you can use to override styles.

rules.root: Root `<section>`. Defines the variables. Receives `className` and `classNames.root`.
rules.size: Size: `--sm`, `--md` or `--lg`. Defines the padding and gap variables.
rules.bordered: Applied with `bordered`. Without a border, `--borderless` is applied.
rules.divided: Applied with `divided`. Line between rows, or inner lines with `bordered`.
rules.striped: Applied with `striped`. Background on even rows, only without `bordered`.
rules.colon: Applied with `colon`; otherwise `--no-colon`. Adds the colon with `::after`.
rules.title: Title. Receives `classNames.title`.
rules.item: Each row. Receives `classNames.item`, the item's `className` and the item's `classNames.item`.
rules.label: `<dt>` with the term. Receives `classNames.label`.

cssVariables.title: CSS variables
cssVariables.description: PropertyList's own variables. The root and size classes define them, so override them with `.gem-property-list.your-class` or your own class in `className`.

items.--gem-property-list-label-width: Width of the label column in horizontal layout. Set by `labelWidth`.
items.--gem-property-list-rule: Color of the border and lines.
items.--gem-property-list-span: Columns an item takes. Set by `span`.

items.--gem-space-{1|2|3|4|6|8|10}: Gaps between rows, columns, label and value.
items.--gem-radius-{sm|md|lg}: Radius of the root and of striped rows.

types.title: Exported types
types.description: Available from @gem-org/gem-system to type your own wrappers.

props.title: Props
props.description: The list also accepts `<section>` attributes (see Inheritance). Pass rows with `items`, with `PropertyList.Item` or both: rows from `items` come first.

items.title: Header. A string renders as an `<h3>`.
items.extra: Content at the end of the header, like a button or badge.
items.layout: `horizontal` puts label and value side by side; `vertical`, one above the other.
items.bordered: Adds a border, background and padding.
items.striped: Background on even rows. Doesn't apply with `bordered`.
items.colon: Adds a colon after the label.
items.labelWidth: Width of the label column in horizontal layout. A number is read as pixels.
items.emptyText: Content shown when the value is empty.

item.title: PropertyListItemConfig / PropertyList.Item
item.description: A row, as an object inside `items` or as a component. `key` and `hidden` only exist on the object.

helpers.title: Helpers
helpers.description: Exported functions used by the component, handy for your own wrappers.

items.clampColumns: Clamps a column count between 1 and 6. Without a value it returns 1.
items.clampSpan: Clamps a `span` between 1 and the column count.
items.collectPropertyListItems: Merges `items` and the `PropertyList.Item` children into one array, without hidden rows.
items.hasPropertyNode: Tells whether a value can be shown: it isn't `null`, `undefined`, a boolean, or an empty or whitespace-only string.
